resharper_align_multiline_implements_list #

Align a wrapped base list with the first base type. Not read by the C# formatter: measured one key away from the export on constructs/wrapping/base-list-alignment.cs, whose base list wraps under the 120-column margin, and false returns it byte-identical. Negative control in the same run: resharper_csharp_align_multiline_extends_list = true — the C# key for the same construct — moves that base list onto the first base type's column.

Typetrue / false
Defaulttrue
Default known fromthe Rider export, which is Rider's default for most keys and the author's choice for the rest, with nothing distinguishing the two
TierD — recorded so the key is not reported unknown; nothing reads it yet
Languagecsharp
Since0.4
Documented athttps://www.jetbrains.com/help/resharper/EditorConfig_Index.html

resharper_wrap_base_clause_style #

The base clause's wrap style, in the language-generic spelling the export writes. ⚠ Probed rather than reasoned about: eleven fixtures under this repository's own .editorconfig, one cleanupcode invocation per configuration, each fixture first shown to move under the key that really governs its construct. Inert at all three values on a base list of five entries that overflows, at 120 and at 60 columns, and with csharp_wrap_extends_list_style = wrap_if_long in the same run — byte-identical to that run without this key. csharp_wrap_extends_list_style is what chops a base list.

Typeone of wrap_if_long, chop_if_long, chop_always
Defaultwrap_if_long
